# Freight Load Exception Intelligence

Capability ID: freight-load-exception-intelligence-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://base44.app/api/apps/69455b200bffe3a07c7bb042/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- what is wrong with this load
- audit this freight load for exceptions
- check this carrier and load paperwork
- find missing POD or rate mismatches
- summarize freight risk on this shipment
- what recoverable charges or detention issues exist

## Problem

A freight operator needs a compact operational picture of a load's exceptions, document gaps, carrier/compliance state and possible financial impact without manually reconciling several records.

## Inputs

Authorized organization scope plus load/freight context; optional documents, carrier, route, compliance and Foundry-derived freight signals.

## Outputs

Exception types/severity, estimated impact and recoverable amount when recorded, document/compliance state, risk flags, evidence refs, unknowns and review actions.

## Pricing

No approved machine price or payment path was verified. Do not auto-quote.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.

Analysis does not authorize dispatch, quote acceptance, carrier contact, claim filing, payment, invoice action or any other external/financial side effect.

Payment authority: No verified payment path for this capability.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
